verdict.rationale: Evidence pack focuses entirely on document-based verification (Document reports, Facial Similarity, NFC chip reads, Watchlist/PEP screening) and no-code capture tools; there is no mention of documentless data checks such as SSN verification, national registry lookups, or credit-header/database-only checks. missing for 10: evidence of SSN/registry/credit-header verification, documentless data-check API or report type, any docs describing a no-doc identity check flow.
